sources.snippet: 🧠 Phi-3 Mini Fine-Tuned (GGUF) — Legal Assistant This is a LoRA fine-tuned version of microsoft/phi-3-mini-4k-instruct converted to GGUF format for use with llama.cpp, Ollama, or compatible runtimes. It was trained on legal documents to act as a context-aware legal assistant that can answer questions from uploaded contracts and policies.
